examples.prompt: Camera move right. A stylized lake with trees, hills, and clouds.
Camera pan right. An aquatic landscape with pebble beach, calm sea, and blue sky.
Camera orbit left. A stylized courtyard with arches, columns, and round table.
Camera pan right. A bedroom corner with wardrobe, chair, and rug.
Camera orbit left. A library aisle with bookshelves, books, and reading table.
Camera push in. A concrete corridor with end wall and light source.
Camera orbit left. A coastal landscape with ocean waves, distant hills, and sunset sky.
Camera move right. A stylized forest with blocky trees, distant hills, and grass.

Camera fixed. Two stylized sharks glide over the underwater landscape, their tails sweeping gently as they pass seaweed and rocky formations. Sunlight filters through the clear water while the seabed remains steady.
Camera fixed. The dog runs quickly across the grassy field, moving forward with alternating legs, open mouth, and perked ears while the fence and trees stay in place.
Camera orbit right. A grand atrium with model city, sculptures, and informational desks.
Camera pull out. A dining area with dining table, chairs, and place settings.
Camera move left. A historic courtyard with garden, pathways, and seating.

Camera move left. A modern conference room with side wall, whiteboard, and chairs. Camera pull out. A modern conference room with entrance door, coat rack, and chairs. Camera pan left. A modern conference room with hallway and artwork.
Camera orbit left. A cozy dining area with bar counter, stools, and tables.
Camera push in. An attic bedroom with tree tops, sunlight, and large window.

Camera pull out. A minimalist workspace with desk, chair, and lamp. Camera pan right. A minimalist workspace with hallway, door, and wall art. Camera move right. A minimalist workspace with hallway, wall art, and small table.

Camera pan left. An aquatic landscape with shoreline, seashells, and distant boat. Camera pull out. An aquatic landscape with sand dunes, beach grass, and seagulls. Camera move left. An aquatic landscape with boardwalk, beachgoers, and umbrellas.

Camera move right. A stylized city street with buildings, pedestrians, and trees. Camera pan right. A stylized city street with park gates, benches, and trees. Camera pull out. A stylized city street with fountain, people, and paved square.

Camera pull out. A living room corner with bookshelf, floor lamp, and small side table. Camera pan right. A living room corner with framed photos, coat rack, and small rug. Camera move right. A dining area with dining table, chairs, and hanging light fixture.
Camera pan left. A modern hallway with geometric walls, adjacent corridor, and metallic ceiling lights.
